# TW Landing Page

lang [RU][home_ru] | [EN][home_en]

## 🚀 Technologies

- HTML x JS (DOM api)
- [TailWind CSS][link0]

## 📋 Description

This repository contains an adaptive layout of a landing page with TailWind CSS framework for fast building styles. [**Demo online**][preview]

![asset0]

### 📌 Features

- Adaptive layout
- Interactive UI elements (burger menu, theme switcher)

## 🏁 Entry Point

The main file to launch the application is `index.html`, located in the project's root directory. For building styles use npm scripts from package-json.

## 📂 Project Structure

```plaintext
img/
  logo.svg
js/
  main.js
index.html
```
